get.summary: Version comparison -- two versions' full snapshots plus which top-level fields differ
get.description:
Registered *before* `/versions/{version}` below on purpose: FastAPI/
Starlette matches routes in registration order, and `{version}` is
typed `int` -- without this ordering, a request for the literal path
segment "compare" would match `/versions/{version}` first and fail
`int` conversion with a spurious 422 instead of ever reaching this
route.

post.description:
`sale_id`/`sale_item_id` are optional and purely additive: passed
through as plain, already-fetched rows to embed in the frozen
`content_snapshot`'s `purchase_information` (Sales Order checkout
calls `PassportService.generate_passport` the same way internally --

post.summary: Confirm (or, with confirm=false, cancel) a proposed write action (FR-9.3)
post.description:
`body.conversation_id` carries what the LLD's `{id}` path segment
alone can't (the LLD names the confirm route `POST /ai/assistant/
actions/{id}/confirm` without specifying whether `{id}` is the
conversation or the message -- `{id}`=`message_id` here since that's
what uniquely identifies "the one proposed action", with
`conversation_id` carried in the body for the ownership check
`AssistantConversationService._get_owned_conversation` performs).
`body.confirm=false` cancels instead -- see `ConfirmAssistantAction
Request`'s own docstring for why this is one endpoint, not two.

AcceptInviteRequest.title: AcceptInviteRequest
AcceptInviteRequest.description:
Consumes an Invite (already-existing `invites` table, Phase 5) to set
the invited user's initial password. Full account provisioning
(creating the Employee + RoleAssignment rows) is Module 5's (User
Management) responsibility — this endpoint only covers the
authentication half: proving the invite token is valid and setting a
password satisfying this module's strength policy.

quantity_delta.title: Quantity Delta
quantity_delta.description: Signed -- positive adds stock, negative removes it. Cannot be zero.

AssistantConversationDetailResponse.title: AssistantConversationDetailResponse
AssistantConversationDetailResponse.description: `GET /ai/assistant/conversations/{id}` -- the conversation's own metadata plus its paginated message log.

conversation_id.title: Conversation Id
conversation_id.description: The conversation this proposed action belongs to (for ownership verification).

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.description: true = execute the proposed action through its normal service-layer validation path (FR-9.3); false = discard the proposal with no side effect (docs/ux/12-ai-workflow-diagrams.md §7's 'No' branch). Both are the same endpoint, matching the LLD's single documented confirm route.

ai_inference_failures_older_than_cutoff.title: Ai Inference Failures Older Than Cutoff

DigitalTwinResponse.description: "Current Digital Twin" -- the read-optimized projection, one row per plant.

DigitalTwinVersionResponse.title: DigitalTwinVersionResponse
DigitalTwinVersionResponse.description: One immutable version -- backs both "Timeline" and "Version history" (see digital_twin_service.py's own note on why they share a shape).

DomainEventResponse.title: DomainEventResponse
DomainEventResponse.description: "Event history" -- the raw `domain_events` rows for this plant, including full payloads (distinct from the twin-shaped `DigitalTwinVersionResponse`).

InventoryLocationType.title: InventoryLocationType
InventoryLocationType.description:
Module 8. Sub-branch physical hierarchy only -- Nursery and Branch
levels already exist as their own tables (organization.py); an
InventoryLocation is always nested under a specific branch_id, never
a standalone Nursery/Branch row duplicated as a location.

InventoryResponse.title: InventoryResponse
InventoryResponse.description:
"Real-Time Stock": Current/Reserved/Damaged/Disposed are real,
persisted `Inventory` columns; `available_quantity` (= quantity -
reserved - damaged) is derived, not stored (avoiding a fifth mutable
column that could drift out of sync with the other four) -- computed
once here by `inventory_response()` rather than left to every route
to recompute individually.

InvoiceResponse.title: InvoiceResponse
InvoiceResponse.description: `payment_status` is derived (sum of Payments vs. total_amount), not a stored column -- see `invoice_response()`.

NotificationCategory.title: NotificationCategory
NotificationCategory.description:
The original eight (`DISEASE_CONFIRMED` through `PURCHASE_ORDER_RECEIVED`)
are docs/ux/14-notification-workflow.md's own Trigger Catalog, seeded
since Phase 5. The remaining thirteen were added by Phase 6 Module 11
(Notifications) to cover its own required event catalog -- see
docs/architecture/27-module11-notifications.md for the full mapping of
each category to the real domain event (existing or newly added) that
drives it, and for the two categories (`RESERVATION_EXPIRING`,
`SYSTEM_ALERT`) that have no automatic scheduled trigger in this
codebase (no Celery worker infrastructure exists anywhere through
Module 10) and are instead reachable via an on-demand endpoint, the
same disclosed pattern Module 10 used for `POST /ai/recommendations/refresh`.

NotificationFrequency.title: NotificationFrequency
NotificationFrequency.description: Added by Phase 6 Module 11 (Notifications). Backs `notification_preferences.frequency` -- the module's required "frequency controls".

NotificationPreferenceUpdateRequest.title: NotificationPreferenceUpdateRequest
NotificationPreferenceUpdateRequest.description: One (category, channel) preference row's desired state -- `PUT /notifications/preferences` accepts a list of these.

PassportResponse.title: PassportResponse
PassportResponse.description: Internal, authenticated view -- includes ids an authorized nursery staff member is entitled to see.

PaymentMethod.title: PaymentMethod
PaymentMethod.description:
Added by Phase 6 Module 9. The module's required tender types. The
pre-existing `payments.method` column (Phase 5) is a free-text
String(50), not a native enum — left as-is (changing an existing
column's type is out of this module's scope and not worth the
migration risk for a display-only field); this enum is instead used
to validate the *value* written into that column at the schema layer,
and is a real native Postgres enum for the brand-new `refunds.method`
column, which has no legacy free-text data to be compatible with.

age_days.title: Age Days
age_days.description: Plant Profile's "Age" -- always derived from `planted_at`, never stored (there is nothing to keep in sync), and serialized into every PlantResponse via Pydantic v2's `@computed_field`.

PublicPassportResponse.title: PublicPassportResponse
PublicPassportResponse.description: The public, unauthenticated view -- no database ids, no nursery/branch/plant id anywhere.

QRScanResponse.title: QRScanResponse
QRScanResponse.description: What scanning a QR must return, per the module's own QR Intelligence spec -- also fully scrubbed of internal ids.

QuotationStatus.title: QuotationStatus
QuotationStatus.description:
Added by Phase 6 Module 9. A Quotation is a non-binding, pre-sale
document; DRAFT/SENT are editable, ACCEPTED/REJECTED/EXPIRED are
terminal, CONVERTED means a SalesOrder has been created from it
(tracked via `sales_orders.quotation_id`, not a back-reference here —
see migration 0013's docstring for why).

ReactivateEmployeeRequest.title: ReactivateEmployeeRequest
ReactivateEmployeeRequest.description: Added by Phase 6 Module 13 (Administration & System Management) -- see `EmployeeService.reactivate_employee`'s own docstring for why a role must be supplied explicitly.

ReplayConsistencyResponse.title: ReplayConsistencyResponse
ReplayConsistencyResponse.description:
Live diagnostic for the module's own "Event replay produces identical
projections" validation requirement: independently recomputes the
projection from the full `domain_events` history and reports whether
it matches the currently-stored twin.

branch_id.title: Branch Id
branch_id.description: Restricts the report to one branch. Omit for an org-wide report.

prediction_type.title: Prediction Type
prediction_type.description: AIPredictionType value, for AI Prediction Reports

ReportFilters.title: ReportFilters
ReportFilters.description:
Every field here is optional -- a given `ReportType` only consumes the
subset relevant to it (see `ReportGenerationService`'s own per-type
provider methods for exactly which). Unused fields are simply ignored
by whichever provider runs, never an error -- callers are not expected
to know each report type's exact filter subset up front.

ReportResponse.title: ReportResponse
ReportResponse.description:
`download_url` -- not `file_url` -- is the only download reference
this API ever returns (see `app/reporting/file_storage.py`'s own
docstring): a stable `/reports/{id}/download` path the download route
resolves server-side, so a client never sees (or could tamper with) a
local filesystem path or an unauthenticated third-party URL directly.

ReportScheduleFrequency.title: ReportScheduleFrequency
ReportScheduleFrequency.description: Added by Phase 6 Module 12. Recurrence for `ScheduledReport` -- deliberately the same three-tier grain `NotificationFrequency`'s digest options already use, not a full cron expression (no scheduler infrastructure in this codebase needs finer granularity -- see `ScheduledReportService`'s own docstring).

ReportType.title: ReportType
ReportType.description:
The original six are the Phase 5 skeleton's own FR-18.2/18.3 set. The
twelve added by Phase 6 Module 12 map one-to-one onto that module's
kickoff spec's "REPORTS" list — see
docs/architecture/28-module12-reports-analytics.md for the full
type-to-data-source mapping. `PLANT_LOSS` (existing) and `PLANT`
(new) are deliberately both kept: `PLANT_LOSS` is the pre-existing,
narrowly-scoped "plants that died" report the LLD's Metrics Catalog
names directly; `PLANT` is the broader plant-portfolio report the
kickoff spec's "Plant Reports" line calls for. `AI_SUMMARY`
(existing) is reused for "AI Prediction Reports" rather than adding a
near-duplicate `AI_PREDICTION` type -- it already covers prediction
accuracy + disease incidence per FR-18.3.

SalesOrderStatus.title: SalesOrderStatus
SalesOrderStatus.description:
Added by Phase 6 Module 9. Backs `sales_orders.order_status` — the
order-lifecycle state machine that sits *before* a Sale (the existing,
immutable Phase-5 "completed transaction" record) is created.
DRAFT -> CONFIRMED -> PROCESSING -> FULFILLED, or -> CANCELLED from
any non-terminal state.

next_run_at.title: Next Run At
next_run_at.description: First run time. Must not be in the past.

ScheduledReportUpdateRequest.title: ScheduledReportUpdateRequest
ScheduledReportUpdateRequest.description: Partial update -- every field optional; only supplied fields change. `PATCH /reports/scheduled/{id}`.

SecurityEventType.title: SecurityEventType
SecurityEventType.description:
Added by Phase 6 Module 2 (Authentication). Backs `security_events`
(app/models/auth.py) — a global, non-tenant-scoped log of
authentication/security activity, distinct from `audit_logs` (which
requires a nursery_id and records *business-data* mutations). Login
attempts happen before an org context exists (a user may not even
resolve to a real account yet), so they cannot live in `audit_logs`.

conversation_id.title: Conversation Id
conversation_id.description: Omit to start a new conversation; provide to continue an existing one you own.

SignupRequest.title: SignupRequest
SignupRequest.description:
Creates a `User` identity only -- see `AuthService.signup`'s
docstring for why organization creation is a separate, subsequent
call (`POST /orgs`, Module 4) rather than bundled into this one.

StockMovementType.title: StockMovementType
StockMovementType.description: Module 8. Every kind of change to a bulk Inventory line funnels through exactly one of these ten types -- one immutable ledger table, not ten.

SystemAlertRequest.title: SystemAlertRequest
SystemAlertRequest.description: Body for `POST /notifications/system-alerts` -- the on-demand trigger for the `SYSTEM_ALERT` category (no scheduler exists in this codebase; see app/domain_events/events.py's `SystemAlertRaised` docstring).

UnitResponse.title: UnitResponse
UnitResponse.description:
Global, system-seeded reference data (migration 0002) -- the unit of
measure dropdown `CreateInventoryLineRequest.unit_id` needs. See
`GET /units`'s summary and `UnitRepository`'s docstring for why this
exists (a real gap found while building 7I: unlike `category_id`,
`unit_id` had no route a caller could use to discover valid ids).

VersionComparisonResponse.title: VersionComparisonResponse
VersionComparisonResponse.description: "Version comparison" -- both full snapshots plus the flat set of top-level keys that differ.
